name: io.github.mindstone/mcp-server-browserbase
title: Browserbase
description: Browserbase MCP server: cloud browser sessions, agents, contexts, fetch, search, functions

environmentVariables.name: BROWSERBASE_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Optional per-request timeout in milliseconds for Browserbase API calls (default 30000).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_WORKSPACE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional workspace directory for local files uploaded to Browserbase (session files, extensions, certificates). File reads are sandboxed to this directory (defaults to the system temp directory when unset).
